newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Rivlin opposes balanced US budget amendment.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Rivlin opposes balanced US budget amendment.

text.p: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Alice Rivlin Tuesday called for higher national savings, but said that a balanced budget amendment to the constitution was not the way to achieve that.
"We should not write it into the constitution," she told the Credit Union National Association. "That's counterproductive."

Rivlin though made clear that she was in favor of fiscal discipline, saying the United States had made considerable progress in cutting its budget deficit in recent years but that more needed to be done.
